availability.name: Research
availability.definition: In labs and papers: no product anyone can buy yet.

availability.name: Pilot
availability.definition: Trials or pilots with named customers or partners, but not generally sold.

availability.name: Early commercial
availability.definition: First products on sale and early customers; the market is still forming.

availability.name: Mature
availability.definition: Sold by several vendors to many customers, in an established market.

availability.definition: The pages don't show how available it is yet.
